cited.quote: promised waiver of co-operative jewel loans and loans to Self Help Groups is also high on the agenda of this Government

rationale: C1 (budget speech) only states the SHG loan waiver is high on the agenda and that inquiries are needed first; no GO or scheme waiving SHG loans, and nothing on the Poo Malai scheme. C2-C5 concern other loans and matters. Not started.

C1-C2 are audit findings on college teacher salaries, C3 on teacher training, C4 on law college appointments, C5 on disaster management staff pay. None concerns periodic pay for the 20,000 teachers in question.
C1-C5 cover roads, metro rail, BharatNet, irrigation and fibre-optic right of way. None mentions the Sethusamudram Shipping Canal Project.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass

rationale: C2 (agriculture budget speech) announces that multi-tier cropping in coconut gardens will be implemented, which is a statement of intent, not a GO. C3-C4 concern coconut peeling wages, C5 a Kuruvai package. No order introducing layer farming for coconut farmers.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass
Popularization of multi-tier cropping system through training and farmers mela (10 Trainings, One Farmers mela)

rationale: C2 is a budget announcement of multi-tier cropping in coconut gardens (intent only). C5 sanctions multi-tier cropping trainings for Shevaroy hills farmers in a fruit-crop demonstration project, not a training programme for coconut farmers. No dedicated coconut layer-farming training shown.

cited.quote: A mobile outreach vehicle to be hired with branding as per prescribed norms from National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu
CAPD support services shall be provided at the doorstep following a Hub and Spoke Model

rationale: C4/C5 are G.O.(Ms) No.340 (2021-08-03) implementing Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam: home-based health services delivered by field teams with a mobile outreach vehicle per block. This brings care to villagers by mobile units, but is outreach rather than mobile hospitals as such; partial.
C1-C4 are COVID lockdown orders on shop timings and C5 amends business facilitation rules for excise licences. None concerns imported fireworks.

cited.quote: the Hon’ble Chief Minister has appointed a Special Officer to resolve all the grievance petitions received during the programme

rationale: C2 reports a Special Officer appointed to resolve petitions received during an earlier programme, which is related grievance activity but not grievance hearing meetings in all constituencies with elected representatives. C1/C5 (MGNREGS ombudsman), C3, C4 are unrelated. Not started.

C1-C5 concern the Madurai Ring Road toll lanes, GST costs and a Thiruvallur bypass. None shows the state urging the Union to approve a 6-lane Chennai-Kanyakumari highway; C1 only names a corridor project director as an addressee.
C1-C2 (Governor's address), C3 (inspection report), C4 (employee health insurance) and C5 (audit of a bus stand) do not mention LIC or any Assembly resolution on its privatisation.
C1-C5 concern SC list amendment, an admissions commission, Finance Commission grants and coconut peeling wages. None mentions LIC or a representation to the Union opposing its privatisation.

cited.quote: Government hereby issues orders for constitution of the Committee for Revival of MSMEs in Tamil Nadu
The Committee is requested to submit its report within three months.

rationale: C2 is G.O.(Ms) No.42 dated 28.07.2021 constituting a Committee for Revival of MSMEs of industrialists, banking and financial experts and Government officials; C1 gives its terms and members. This is the promised expert committee.

cited.quote: Agricultural Zonal Committees will be formed to protect the farmers from natural calamities

rationale: C3 (agriculture budget speech) only announces that Agricultural Zonal Committees will be formed; no order forming them or issuing recommendations to farmers. C2/C4 concern crop insurance notification, a different scheme. Not started.
C1-C2 cover barrier-free buildings, C3-C4 an equal opportunity policy, C5 employee health insurance ID cards. None concerns smart cards for persons with disabilities.

cited.quote: which is 9 months (270 days) at present, be enhanced to 12 months (365 days), with effect from 01.07.2021

rationale: C2 is G.O.(Ms) No.84 dated 23.08.2021 enhancing maternity leave of women Government servants from 9 to 12 months (effective 01.07.2021); C1/C3 clarify its application. Matches the promise.

cited.quote: To provide a focus on the textile sector, a separate Directorate of Textiles will be created.

rationale: C1 (budget speech) only announces that a Directorate of Textiles will be created; no GO creating Textile Development Commissions. C2-C5 are unrelated. Not started.
C1 covers general fishermen relief and harbours; C2-C5 are local body and livelihood mission grants. None concerns daily compensation to families of missing fishermen.

cited.quote: Improving efficiency in expenditure and accounting for probable fiscal contingencies without compromising on growth creating expenditure

rationale: C1/C4 (budget speech, fiscal plan) state aims to improve expenditure efficiency and rationalise revenue expenditure, which are mentions only; no dedicated order curbing wasteful spending by Ministers and officials. C2, C3, C5 unrelated.

cited.quote: The total provision for the Tamil Nadu Slum Clearance Board in the Revised Budget Estimates 2021-22 is Rs.3,954.44 crore

rationale: C1 gives a budget provision for the Slum Clearance Board and slum-free aims, a broader related subject; nothing allots new houses to fishermen in deteriorated board houses. C2-C5 unrelated. Not started.
C1-C5 concern an industrial corridor, MRTS feasibility studies and metro rail. None mentions a Madurai-Aruppukottai-Thoothukudi broad gauge rail line.
